paper.title_en: Black hole thermodynamics at null infinity. Part 2: Open systems, Markovian dynamics and work extraction from non-rotating black holes
paper.abstract_en: Black hole thermodynamics provides a unique setting in which general relativity, quantum field theory, and statistical mechanics converge. In semiclassical gravity, this interplay culminates in the generalized second law (GSL), whose modern proofs rely on information theoretic techniques applied to algebras of observables defined on null hypersurfaces. These proofs exhibit close structural parallels with the thermodynamics of open quantum systems governed by Markovian dynamics. In this work, we draw parallels between the dynamics of quantum fields in regions bounded by non expanding causal horizons and the thermodynamics of quantum systems weakly coupled to equilibrium reservoirs. We introduce a dictionary relating late time boundary conditions to the choice of reservoir, vacuum states to fixed points of the dynamics, and modular Hamiltonians to thermodynamic potentials. Building on results from a companion paper on dual generalized second laws at future null infinity, we show that additional terms appearing in the associated thermodynamic potentials admit a natural interpretation as work contributions. We demonstrate that certain non thermal vacuum states at null infinity allow for the operation of autonomous thermal engines and enable work extraction from the radiation. Extending the analysis to the Unruh vacuum in Schwarzschild and Kerr backgrounds, we obtain generalized grand potential type laws incorporating grey body effects and angular momentum fluxes. Altogether, our results clarify the thermodynamic description of black hole dynamics and place it within the broader framework of open quantum thermodynamics.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文深入探讨了黑洞热力学与开放量子系统热力学的联系，提出了新的字典映射和引力势修正的工作解释，理论深度高，方法严谨，具有较高新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 零无穷远处的黑洞热力学. 第2部分：开放系统、马尔可夫动力学与非旋转黑洞的功提取
decision.abstract_zh: 黑洞热力学提供了一个独特的环境，其中广义相对论、量子场论和统计力学汇聚。在半经典引力中，这种相互作用最终体现在广义第二定律（GSL）中，其现代证明依赖于应用于定义在类光超曲面上的可观测代数上的信息论技术。这些证明与由马尔可夫动力学支配的开放量子系统的热力学表现出密切的结构相似性。在这项工作中，我们将无扩张因果视界所界定的区域中量子场的动力学与弱耦合到平衡热库的量子系统的热力学进行了类比。我们引入了一个词典，将晚期边界条件与热库的选择、真空态与动力学的固定点、模哈密顿量与热力学势联系起来。基于一篇姊妹论文中关于未来零无穷远处双重广义第二定律的结果，我们表明相关的热力学势中出现的额外项具有作为功贡献的自然解释。我们证明，零无穷远处的某些非热真空态允许自主热机的运行，并能够从辐射中提取功。将分析扩展到施瓦西和克尔背景中的安鲁真空，我们获得了包含灰体效应和角动量通量的广义巨势型定律。总的来说，我们的结果阐明了黑洞动力学的热力学描述，并将其置于开放量子热力学的更广泛框架内。
